comparisons.name: stack-light
comparisons.description: The leading end of the stack in Aqua: eight windows behind the front one, six with a title bar and window controls and two blank. The blurred sky behind is a gradient of the colours measured there. No text is in the crop, so this is the drawing: the perspective (where each window's top edge and leading edge fall), the fading and the veil. What remains is the ring round each window control, which the stack does not draw, and the picture showing through the translucent windows.

comparisons.name: stack-dark
comparisons.description: The leading end of the stack in Dark Aqua, where the oldest backup is shown and all eight windows behind it are blank. Gates the perspective and the blank window's fill and top line; the backdrop is a gradient of the colours measured beside the stack.

comparisons.name: buttons-light
comparisons.description: Cancel and the disabled Restore in Aqua, over a gradient of the colours measured around them. The budgets allow for the two titles in the fallback font.

comparisons.name: buttons-drawing-light
comparisons.description: The same with the two titles masked: the faces, which are added to the backdrop, their top line and their corners.

comparisons.name: buttons-dark
comparisons.description: Cancel and the disabled Restore in Dark Aqua. The budgets allow for the two titles in the fallback font.

comparisons.name: buttons-drawing-dark

comparisons.name: arrows-light
comparisons.description: The two arrows and the date in Aqua. The budgets allow for the date in the fallback font.

comparisons.name: arrows-drawing-light
comparisons.description: The same with the date masked: the two faces, their distance from each other and the chevrons.

comparisons.name: arrows-dark

comparisons.name: timeline-light

comparisons.name: timeline-dark

comparisons.name: timeline-drawing-dark

comparisons.name: cancel-focus-light
comparisons.description: Keyboard focus on Cancel in Aqua, reached with Tab past the window's close button and the two arrows. No screenshot shows it: the ring is the shared focus ring, outside the button's edge.

comparisons.name: cancel-pressed-dark
comparisons.description: Cancel held down in Dark Aqua. No screenshot shows a pressed button: the face becomes --mac-time-machine-browser-control-pressed (provisional), which is added to the backdrop like the normal face.

comparisons.name: timeline-long-newest
comparisons.description: Sixty backups on a timeline with room for fifteen: the newest, which is shown at first, is in view at the lower end. No screenshot shows it.

pixels.note: tick of the backup shown, the last one, in the lowest slot: --mac-time-machine-browser-tick-selected
a plain tick in the highest slot: the backdrop #102030 plus 76 levels (computed from the tokens)
